title: Decompose Make-based build/release shims into Go presubmit/wrangler binary and add safe-dep-unlocker
author: Asha Kapoor
release_notes: Replaces legacy Makefile/ bash presubmit and release shims with a single small Go binary (presubmit-wrangler). Adds safe-dep-unlocker tool to coordinate staggered dependency upgrades and avoid mass CI churn. Non-breaking; rollout via staged canary on the CI fast-path.
description:
Summary: Replace a patchwork of Makefile targets and ad-hoc bash release presubmit scripts with a compact Go-based presubmit/wrangler binary and introduce a small 'safe-dep-unlocker' helper to coordinate dependency rollouts. This reduces CI flakiness caused by long shell init sequences, centralizes telemetry for presubmit actions, and provides a safe path for batched dependency upgrades.

Motivation: Over time we've accumulated multiple Make targets and bash shims used at presubmit and release time (make release:prepare, scripts/ci-boot, scripts/release_sign). They are fragile (set -e traps, subtle env assumptions) and slow to startup. They also duplicate logging and exit semantics, making CI flakes hard to triage. This PR: (1) consolidates those behaviors into presubmit-wrangler (single binary invoked by CI job), (2) decomposes monolithic Makefile bits into small go packages used by the binary, and (3) adds safe-dep-unlocker — a lightweight coordinator that gates broad dependency bumps so we can stagger merges through canaries.

What changed (high level):
- New binary: tools/presubmit-wrangler (go cmd) — handles: workspace bootstrap, selective vendoring, env validation, artifact signing handshake, and structured JSON telemetry emitted to CI.
- New helper: tools/safe-dep-unlocker — REST-lite coordinator (file-backed lease) used by the dep-bot to get a temporary unlock token for repo-wide dependency rollouts.
- Makefile: reduced to minimal task map that delegates to the Go binary for heavy lifting (Makefile -> make phony targets now wrappers only).
- CI: workflow updates in .github/workflows/* to call presubmit-wrangler instead of scripts/* or inlined shell. Added a short-lived 'ci-presubmit-logger' step that consumes presubmit-wrangler structured output.
- Release automation: moved signing handshake (gpg/ossls wrapper) into presubmit-wrangler and added a retry/backoff for transient KMS failures.
- Tests: unit tests for new packages under tools/* and integration smoke under .github/workflows/ci-smoke.yml (fast path).
- Docs: updated CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/ci/README-presubmit.md to document the new flow.

Checklist (all completed):
- [x] Implement presubmit-wrangler and safe-dep-unlocker
- [x] Replace CI references to old scripts/make targets
- [x] Ship unit tests and a fast smoke CI lane
- [x] Update docs and quickstarts that referenced old Make targets
- [x] Coordinate with dep-bot config (stagger windows)
- [x] Run canary on infra repo and two SDK repos for one week

Commits (summary):
- a7c4f8c  introducer: add tools/presubmit-wrangler cmd and basic telemetry sink
- b3d2e2a  decompose: move make targets to small go packages (env, vendor, sign)
- c9f7b11  ci: update workflows to call presubmit-wrangler and attach JSON output
- d4e6a00  tooling: add safe-dep-unlocker with file-lease backend and lock TTL
- e5aee22  tests: add unit tests for env and sign packages; add ci-smoke workflow
- f11a99d  docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md and add presubmit README

Files touched (selective, representative):
- tools/presubmit-wrangler/main.go
- tools/presubmit-wrangler/{env.go,vendor.go,sign.go,telemetry.go}
- tools/safe-dep-unlocker/main.go
- Makefile (reduced wrappers)
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (call presubmit-wrangler step)
- .github/workflows/ci-smoke.yml (new fast lane)
- scripts/* (deleted: scripts/ci-boot, scripts/release_sign)

Testing and verification:
- Local: ran make smoke via presubmit-wrangler (dev mode) across macOS and Linux containers.
- CI: Introduced a canary label (ci.canary/true) and ran on infra and redwood-sdk-python repos. Observed 22% faster average boot (median 11s reduction) and 45% fewer flaky timeouts in the bootstrap phase.
- Dep unlocker: ran a simulated unlock across 3 repos and verified the TTL/lease semantics prevented two concurrent unlocks for the same org namespace.

Review discussion (important threads condensed):
- Liam Chen: "This looks sensible, biggest concern is user-facing error messages from the Go binary — can we preserve the same exit codes the CI expects?"
  - Response (Asha): "Yes — presubmit-wrangler maps common failures to existing exit codes. Added tests that assert exit code mapping for vendor/lock/sign failures (see tests/exitcode_test.go)."
- Noah Patel: "We should avoid introducing a network dependency for safe-dep-unlocker in CI. Is the file-lease backend robust across our ephemeral runners?"
  - Response (Asha): "safe-dep-unlocker defaults to file-lease for ephemeral runners and supports an optional gcs/kv backend via env vars. Added TTL and a fallback to heartbeat mode; documented in docs/ci/safe-dep-unlocker.md."
- Maya Rodriguez: "Telemetry looks great, but please ensure secrets are never logged. Confirm KMS errors don't dump keys."
  - Response (Asha): "Telemetry excludes any envs named *KEY* or *SECRET* by default. sign.go scrubs error blobs before emitting. CI tests exercise the KMS transient failure path without exposing secrets."
- Noah (follow-up): "Can the dep-bot be updated to use the unlocker?"
  - Response (Asha): "Yes — dep-bot config change is queued in a separate PR on the dep-bot repo; safe windows and unlock policy are included in linked Linear task ENG-1129."

CI checks: All required checks passed after one rerun of flaky integration test:
- unit-tests: pass
- go vet/staticcheck: pass
- integration-smoke (fast lane): pass
- release-signing-sim: pass
- e2e-long (optional nightly): pending (not required for merge)

Rollout plan:
1) Merge to main behind feature flag (CI step name 'presubmit.mode' defaulting to 'legacy' unless repo opt-in).
2) Opt-in infra and SDK repos to canary lane for 7 days. Monitor presubmit error telemetry and boot-time.
3) Flip default after no regressions for two weeks; then deprecate old scripts/ and remove Make wrappers in a follow-up cleanup PR.

Merge details: Squash-merged to main after reviews and green CI. Author performed the merge to ensure signed commits trace to infra automation account for release signing changes.

Notes and follow-ups (separate PRs planned):
- dep-bot config PR to actually call safe-dep-unlocker with unlock windows (ENG-1129).
- Remove legacy scripts/ entirely after three-week grace period.
- Add optional central gcs/kv backend for safe-dep-unlocker for org-wide coordinated rollouts (design doc in INF-430).

If you want a focused walk-through I can demo the presubmit-wrangler flow and the unlocker in the rewired CI job — ping me and I will schedule a 30m session.

References: ENG-1129, INF-430, SUP-8812.
discussion_summary: Mostly technical sign-off after minor adjustments: ensure exit code compatibility; avoid adding cloud deps for unlocker by default; redact secrets in telemetry. Dep-bot update is tracked separately.
notes_for_release_manager: Non-breaking. No action required from release manager beyond watching presubmit telemetry during canary. Signing flow has retry/backoff but preserves existing artifact format.
